Tamil Nadu has been hit by an alleged cyber attack involving government bank accounts, with around ₹22 crore reportedly lost in the suspected fraud.
The alleged cyber fraud has raised serious questions over the security of government funds and banking systems. The incident has also turned into a political controversy in Tamil Nadu.
The BJP has questioned Chief Minister Vijay over the alleged loss of ₹22 crore and demanded answers from his government. Police and authorities are investigating the alleged cyber attack and the circumstances surrounding the transfer of the funds.
